strategies.reason: Approved 18 November 2026 (docs/design-review/2026-11-18/regime-gate-and-bollinger-squeeze.md, option A): Bollinger (2001) squeeze. Previous session band width in the lowest 15% of its 60 widths, close above the 10-session high, volume at least 1.5x the 20-session median, close in the top quarter of the range, SPY above its rising 50-day average (higher than 20 sessions earlier), for Nasdaq-listed stocks QQQ under the same rule, and FRED VIXCLS previous-session sizing (full 0.5% risk below 18, half risk 18-22, no new longs above 22). Next-open entry, 1 ATR stop, 2.5R target, 10-session time exit, as-traded bars on a whole-market ADR% >= 2.5 screen. Diagnostic backtest research only.

Approved 19 November 2026 (docs/design-review/2026-11-19/swing-8-strategies-and-ui-design.md, Checkpoint 5): 21-EMA trend pullback (ATR-14 control). Stock above rising 50-day SMA (higher than 20 sessions earlier), strategy-owned 20-session ADR% >= 2.5% and average daily dollar volume >= $20M, 1-5 bar low-volume pullback (RVOL < 0.85) into within 0.5 * ATR(14) of the 21-day EMA while pullback and trigger lows stay at or above the 50-day SMA, trigger bar closes above EMA(21) and prior session high, under the SPY/QQQ rising 50-day SMA and FRED VIXCLS sizing gate. Next-open entry, 1.0 ATR(14) stop, 2.5R target, 10-session time exit, as-traded bars. Diagnostic backtest research only.

Approved 19 November 2026 (docs/design-review/2026-11-18/experiment-v2-01-median-true-range.md and docs/design-review/2026-11-19/swing-8-strategies-and-ui-design.md, Checkpoint 5): Experiment V2-01 MTR-14 treatment of technical.ema21-trend-pullback@1.0.0. Identical entry signals, regime/VIX sizing, 10-session time exit, and costs; replaces Wilder ATR(14) with MTR-14 (median of 14 completed True Ranges) for the 1.0-unit initial stop and 2.5R target. Diagnostic backtest research only.

Approved 19 November 2026 (docs/design-review/2026-11-19/swing-8-strategies-and-ui-design.md, Checkpoint 6): Rubber-band reclaim. Stock above rising 50-day SMA (higher than 20 sessions earlier), strategy-owned 20-session ADR% >= 2.5% and average daily dollar volume >= $20M, prior stretch bar within 3 sessions closing both below the lower Bollinger Band and with RSI(2) < 10 with a 48-hour fresh-news veto, trigger bar closing above the prior session high, under the SPY/QQQ rising 50-day SMA and FRED VIXCLS sizing gate. Next-open entry, 1.0 ATR(14) stop, 2.5R target, 10-session time exit, as-traded bars. Diagnostic backtest research only.

Approved 19 November 2026 (docs/design-review/2026-11-18/swing-orb-and-vix-gate-proposal.md Option B and docs/design-review/2026-11-19/swing-8-strategies-and-ui-design.md, Checkpoint 4): Swing ORB on Tier-1 news. Requires a Tier-1 catalyst (earnings, guidance, fda, contract, upgrade) within 18 hours under a +5-minute conservative receipt delay with FinBERT negative veto (<= -0.15 across the window), opening gap up >= 0.75 * ATR(14)_{D-1}, first-30m (09:30-10:00 NY) RVOL >= 2.0 vs prior 20-session median opening volume, daily close above both 09:30-10:00 NY high and session VWAP, strategy-owned 20-session ADR% >= 2.5% and average daily dollar volume >= $20M, under the SPY/QQQ rising 50-day SMA and FRED VIXCLS sizing gate. Next-open entry, 1.0 ATR(14) stop, 2.5R target, 10-session time exit, as-traded bars. Diagnostic backtest research only.

Approved 19 November 2026 (docs/design-review/2026-11-19/swing-8-strategies-and-ui-design.md, Checkpoints 7 & 8): Short mirror of Bollinger squeeze breakout. Prior session Bollinger band width in lowest 15% of 60 widths, close below 10-session low, RVOL >= 1.5, close in bottom quarter (CLV <= 0.25), strategy-owned ADR% >= 2.5% and dollar volume >= $20M, under bearish SPY/QQQ falling 50-day SMA gate and short FRED VIXCLS sizing (< 18 refused, 18-22 half risk, > 22 full risk). Charges 1.0% annualized short-borrow fee and enforces SEC Rule 201. Next-open short entry, 1.0 ATR(14) stop, 2.5R target, 10-session time exit, as-traded bars. Diagnostic backtest research only.

Approved 19 November 2026 (docs/design-review/2026-11-19/swing-8-strategies-and-ui-design.md, Checkpoints 7 & 8): Short Swing ORB on negative Tier-1 news (Option B). Requires negative Tier-1 catalyst (earnings, guidance, fda, downgrade) within 18 hours with +5-minute conservative receipt delay, negative cue or FinBERT < 0, and positive FinBERT veto (>= +0.15 across the window), gap down >= 0.75 * ATR(14)_{D-1}, first-30m RVOL >= 2.0, opening range stays <= session VWAP, daily close below both 09:30-10:00 NY low and session VWAP, strategy-owned ADR% >= 2.5% and dollar volume >= $20M, under bearish SPY/QQQ falling 50-day SMA gate and short FRED VIXCLS sizing. Charges 1.0% annualized short-borrow fee and enforces SEC Rule 201. Next-open short entry, 1.0 ATR(14) stop, 2.5R target, 10-session time exit, as-traded bars. Diagnostic backtest research only.

Approved 19 November 2026 (docs/design-review/2026-11-19/swing-8-strategies-and-ui-design.md, Checkpoints 7 & 8): Short 21-EMA trend rejection breakdown (ATR-14 control). Stock below falling 50-day SMA (lower than 20 sessions earlier), strategy-owned ADR% >= 2.5% and dollar volume >= $20M, 1-5 bar weak bounce (RVOL < 0.85) into within 0.5 * ATR(14) of EMA(21) while all highs stay <= SMA(50), trigger closes below EMA(21) and prior session low, under bearish SPY/QQQ falling 50-day SMA gate and short FRED VIXCLS sizing. Charges 1.0% annualized short-borrow fee and enforces SEC Rule 201. Next-open short entry, 1.0 ATR(14) stop, 2.5R target, 10-session time exit, as-traded bars. Diagnostic backtest research only.

Approved 19 November 2026 (docs/design-review/2026-11-18/experiment-v2-01-median-true-range.md and docs/design-review/2026-11-19/swing-8-strategies-and-ui-design.md, Checkpoints 7 & 8): Experiment V2-01 MTR-14 short treatment of technical.ema21-rejection-short@1.0.0. Identical entry signals, bearish SPY/QQQ/VIX short sizing, borrow fee, SEC Rule 201, and 10-session time exit; replaces Wilder ATR(14) with MTR-14 (median of 14 completed True Ranges) for the 1.0-unit initial stop and 2.5R target. Diagnostic backtest research only.

Approved 19 November 2026 (docs/design-review/2026-11-19/swing-8-strategies-and-ui-design.md, Checkpoints 7 & 8): Parabolic exhaustion shooting-star breakdown. Prior bar spikes >= 2.5 * ATR(14)_{D-1} above EMA(21)_{D-1} on a shooting star (upper wick >= 2.0 * max(|Close - Open|, 0.01), CLV <= 0.35), trigger closes below prior bar low, strategy-owned ADR% >= 2.5% and dollar volume >= $20M, under bearish SPY/QQQ falling 50-day SMA gate and short FRED VIXCLS sizing. Charges 1.0% annualized short-borrow fee and enforces SEC Rule 201. Next-open short entry, 1.0 ATR(14) stop, 2.5R target, 10-session time exit, as-traded bars. Diagnostic backtest research only.
